title: Reading reply (one call per batch of disagreements)
description: What the model must answer for a batch of disagreements between an editor's outcome and the agent's proposal: one reading per row. The shape is checked here; that every key of the batch is present exactly once and no other key, that the rule names a rule that exists for the row's tag, and that the note is at most 25 words is checked in code (lib/readings.mjs checkReadings), against the batch.

key.description: The key given in the row block, copied exactly.

rule.description: The rule the reading points at, written "<the tag name> rule <n>", or null when no single rule is the point.

note.description: One sentence of at most 25 words, to the editor, in plain words.
